# markdown-badges-collection

> Copy-paste Shields.io badges for GitHub README and profile: tech, framework and tool badges with official brand colors and Simple Icons logos.

This catalog has 191 badges in 12 categories. Each badge is a static Shields.io badge: `https://img.shields.io/badge/<Name>-<HEX>?logo=<simple-icons-slug>&logoColor=<white|black>`.

## Resources
- [Searchable catalog](https://pawang-ai.github.io/markdown-badges-collection/): browse, filter and copy badges
- [badges.json](https://pawang-ai.github.io/markdown-badges-collection/badges.json): machine-readable list of all badges
- [README (English)](https://github.com/pawang-ai/markdown-badges-collection/blob/main/README.md)
- [README (Bahasa Indonesia)](https://github.com/pawang-ai/markdown-badges-collection/blob/main/README.id.md)

- Framework & Library: 55
- Build Tool & Linter: 14
- Programming Language & Runtime: 11

- DevOps & Infrastructure: 28
- Operating System & Network: 8
- Code Editor & Developer Tool: 21
